column2: the testing grep checklist is too narrow for the stated dedup goal. the plan removes the opening round-matrix prose (e.g. full static diagonal, rounds 2–5 generic codex, reviewer-prune) plus step 3 archetype enumeration, but testing strategy only greps for arch/innovation/pragmatic/requirements. an implementer could satisfy the grep while leaving line 10 matrix prose intact and partially miss the feature intent.

plan.txt:104-108 [scope-reduction] grep checklist cannot verify opening-summary matrix removal. scenario: opening summary (skills/design/skill.md:10) never names arch/innovation/pragmatic/requirements; it hardcodes round topology via "full static diagonal", "rounds 2-5", and "review reviewer-prune". an implementer can leave that matrix in place, pass the planned grep, and miss the primary opening-summary deliverable.

the plan routes skill readers to `skills/design/references/plan-review.md` for panel topology after removing archetype names from `skills/design/skill.md`, but the reconcile spec does not make that file a usable topology home. `consumer` and `when to load` still limit prompt-side use to judgment, artifact contracts, dedup, tally interpretation, templates, and mainagent adjudication; they do not authorize panel topology or static slot identity. the file also omits the four static slugs (`arch`, `innovation`, `pragmatic`, `requirements`) that `skills/shared/topology.tsv` already attributes to this path. after the change, operators following skill pointers land on prose that both forbids and omits the migrated topology content.

the plan removes arch/innovation/pragmatic/requirements from the step 3 important and spawn-order prose and defers topology to `plan-review.md`, but it does not update the step 3 mandatory block at `skills/design/skill.md:579`. that block still limits `plan-review.md` to semantic dedup, voting-tally interpretation, artifact templates, and mainagent adjudication only. an orchestrator can follow the mandatory load without a normative topology mandate while other skill prose says topology lives elsewhere.

the plan replaces the round-topology parenthetical and adds a `plan-review.md` pointer but also says to keep the opening summary intact. line 10 of `skills/design/skill.md` currently ends with `as documented in this file` immediately after matrix prose. if the matrix moves out of skill but that phrase remains, the opening summary points readers back to skill for topology that is no longer present.

the plan extends consumer and when-to-load to authorize panel topology and static slot identity, and skill defers topology reads to `plan-review.md`, but the contract bullet still says prompt-side orchestration uses this file only for the surviving judgment and artifact contracts listed above. topology and static slug identity are reference contracts, not judgment or artifact templates. an orchestrator can read the expanded consumer list, then hit contract and treat topology as loop-internal or forbidden prompt-side load, recreating the authority confusion failure mode 3 targets only via consumer/when-to-load. failure mode 3 checks consumer/when-to-load and static slugs but not this contract tail.
